content.text:
Body rows on the orders page now have 6px of padding above and below, down from 12px. The heading row is unchanged. The 16 functional tests pass, but I didn't open the page in a browser to check how it looks.

The change is a new rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`, limited to `.page-orders .table tbody td`. The pricing page uses the same `.table` class, so I scoped the rule to the orders page to keep pricing as it was.

The "View" button in each row may be taller than the text, in which case rows will shrink a little less than the padding change alone suggests.

STATUS: DONE
